title: What Happens When a Child Gets Sick in a Refugee Camp? Inside the Rohingya Health Crisis
excerpt: A child wakes up with a fever. Their parent wants to get help. But the clinic is far away, water is hard to access, and there is little food at home. What should they deal with first? For many families in Cox’s Bazar, these problems are connected. The Rohingya health crisis is about more than one illness.
